info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Webhook Endpoint Management API
info.description: The Webhook Endpoint Management API facilitates the removal of specific webhook endpoints within your application. By targeting individual endpoints, users can effectively manage their integration points, maintaining streamlined operations and reducing unnecessary payloads. This API is essential for developers and system administrators who need to adapt their webhook configurations in response to evolving business needs. Typical use cases include decommissioning obsolete integrations or troubleshooting issues in real-time data flows.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to delete a specific webhook endpoint identified by its unique resource ID. Ensure that the endpoint you are trying to delete is no longer needed or has been successfully migrated before performing this operation.

requestBody.description: A request body containing the necessary parameters for the deletion of the specified webhook endpoint. Ensure that all required fields are included to successfully remove the webhook.

204.description: Request successfully processed with no content returned.
